help.title: About fostering
help.what: Fostering means caring for a rescued dog or cat in your own home until it finds a permanent family.
help.costs: Food, bedding and vet bills are covered by the rescue; you provide care and a calm home.
help.form: The form has five parts that can be answered in any order. Everything is stored as you type, so you can stop and return using the reference.
help.after: After you send it, the foster team will call to arrange a visit.
